dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effects of several cover crop options, along with nitrogen (N) application and winter wheat residue management, on processing tomato yield and profitability in Ontario’s temperate humid climate, using farm-level financial analysis.
dct_rights_sm: Permission from the author must be requested to access this dataset. This dataset may be used for educational or research purposes.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Effects of cover crop, N and residue management on the financial sustainability of processing tomatoes in Southwestern Ontario
